j4q.shaders

Class NormalMapMatCapShader

  • java.lang.Object
    • j4q.models.Component
      • j4q.shaders.Shader
        • j4q.shaders.NormalMapMatCapShader

  • public class NormalMapMatCapShader
extends Shader
    Shader for rendering objects with MatCap and normal map textures.

    Supports animated effects, normal mapping, and stylized MatCap shading.
